why: install, report and remove the runner with the system's own service manager

observe.shell: copy "{case}\runner.toml" "{tmp}\runner.toml" >nul && "{runner}" --config "{tmp}\runner.toml" install --mode service --name rbit-runner.eval-service --no-start && "{runner}" --config "{tmp}\runner.toml" status --mode service --name rbit-runner.eval-service & "{runner}" --config "{tmp}\runner.toml" uninstall --mode service --name rbit-runner.eval-service & "{runner}" --config "{tmp}\runner.toml" status --mode service --name rbit-runner.eval-service
